thread:
Sophie (People Ops): Quick midday check-in: privacy + SOC2/ISO evidence due end of week (Fri 23:59 UTC). Were at ~64% training completion org-wide. Need help getting to 100% :pray: Please confirm an owner and attach evidence links in the spreadsheet.

ComplianceBot: Auto-report: Training modules completed: 64%. Pending reminders scheduled (@72h, @24h, @1h).

Omar (Eng): Ping 4! For any Eng teams: we've created a small helper script to gather runbooks + access lists. Uploads go to the secure portal (S3): https://secure-upload.redwood.internal/compliance/2026.

Priya (Eng-SRE): Thanks Omar. Can you drop the script here? Prefer something that strips PII and secrets automatically.

Omar (Eng): Sure. Snippet:
```
# redact secrets and bundle runbook
python tools/collect_evidence.py --service service-name --out /tmp/evidence.tar.gz --redact=secrets,pii
```
Note: tool adds a manifest.json with filenames and SHA256.

Alex (Security): Important: for SOC2 scoped systems we still need unredacted provenance logs available via the secure portal (auditors get access only). If you must redact locally, keep a mapping in the secure manifest and add 'secure_upload' flag in the spreadsheet.

Nina (Legal): Reminder: vendor DPAs must be in place for any third-party services in scope. If procurement hasn't completed a DPA, escalate to contracts@. We can't include vendor artifacts until DPA is attached.

Maya (Audit): Process note: Audit team will sample 3 services per org. We'll verify runbooks + incident timelines + one week's raw logs for each sampled service. Add 'audit_sample_ok' in the sheet if you're ready.

Sophie (People Ops): We're seeing a handful of teams with low training completion who also have open oncall rotations. If you need a short training window (30m) that managers can book for the team, we can run a recorded session tomorrow 14:00 UTC. RSVP in this thread.

DevToolsBot: Heads-up: evidence template v2 uploaded to the drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/compliance/template-v2.md. Use that file name convention: org_service_evidence-v2.tar.gz

Priya (Eng-SRE): Small question on logs: do you accept aggregated token-level metrics for hosted API services, or do you need full request traces?

Alex (Security): Aggregates are fine for non-scoped services. For any service processing customer data in scope for ISO/SOC2, we need request traces showing request_id, timestamp, service instance id. Redact payloads.

Omar (Eng): I've assigned myself as attestation_owner for Search infra and added the link to the spreadsheet.

Sophie (People Ops): Thanks Omar. Everyone: please fill the "attestation_owner" and "evidence_link" columns in the master spreadsheet by EOD Friday. If your evidence contains secrets, note 'secure_upload' and use the secure portal link above.

Nina (Legal): Also note: privacy training certs are required for all people with access to customer PII. Managers must verify this before submitting attestation.

Maya (Audit): If you'd like a pre-check, DM me the evidence link and I'll do a 15-min review. We're prioritizing teams with customer-facing services.

Sophie (People Ops): Final note: execs will review a compliance recap next Monday. If you see anything that might block sign-off, flag it here ASAP.

Omar (Eng): RSVP for the 14:00 UTC session.

Priya (Eng-SRE): Can we get an export of who still needs training by team? Makes follow-ups easier.

ComplianceBot: Export available: https://redwood.internal/compliance/reports/pending-training-2026.csv

Sophie (People Ops): Perfect. I'll follow up with team managers. Thanks all. :sparkles:
